name: Abraham Van Helsing
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets (the Horseman's style), redrawn from the flat-cartoon kit (sources/old_style/). Transylvania's seat 1, drawn facing right. The master is the rest pose's OWN head (spectacles on); eyes and mouths are layers on it. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. The doctor's bag stands on the felt by his left elbow (the left of the picture) in every pose: a props box in the near forearm's piece and every frame. No drop_wood: there is no chair behind him, and it took his auburn hair in most frames. The diary's book and hands are a props box too (their brown was taken for the rail's).

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, spectacles on, the bag by his left elbow
what.A3: Check: two fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward, deliberate
what.A6: Fold: a flat push of the hand toward the middle
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both fists raised, a delighted laugh (`win_big`)
what.B4: Takes off his spectacles and cleans them on a white handkerchief
what.B5: Writes a line in a leather diary (decoy for B4)
what.B6: Touches the crucifix at his collar
what.C1: Checks a pocket that smells of garlic (decoy for B6)
what.C3: Sniffs the air, frowning (decoy for C2)
what.C4: Glances at the fireplace, over his right shoulder
what.C5: Peers over the top of his spectacles at the viewer
what.C6: Settles his spectacles back on his nose with one finger
what.D2: Facing a big bet: brows drawn down, studying
what.D3: Lost a pot: a heavy sigh, a shake of the head
what.D4: Crushing loss: spectacles pushed up, a hand over his eyes (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms, eyes keen
what.D6: A short, warm laugh, head tipped back

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the doctor's bag by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
